decisions.reason: As a flagship cloud email service tightly aligned with the firm's strategic direction and core capabilities, its option value and strategic importance clearly outweigh its likely carrying cost.
The product extends the established workflow offer and already shows a concrete customer-use signal, so management would likely continue backing it rather than abandon a promising option.

This conversion service fits the firm's installed messaging base and can still create value in regulated German communication processes, so the firm would likely keep it while demand remains somewhat uncertain.
As a narrower fax-related feature with weaker independent evidence of traction, it is the most likely candidate to be removed so resources can be shifted to stronger cloud and security options.

Threat protection is strategically complementary to the firm's secure messaging position, and despite some portfolio-pruning risk in adjacent security tools, the product still has enough option value to retain.
